meanings.note: условный срок = a suspended sentence

Условный знак = an agreed signal. Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'словный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('conditional; agreed; suspended (sentence)').

examples.text: А я тебе делаю условный срок. Плюс ты забираешь все деньги Вики.
examples.trans: And I get you a suspended sentence. Plus you take all of Vika's money.
